principle: Structured Georgia public data and official entity sources are preferred. Discovery sources never replace official validation.

connectors.name: Georgia Department of Community Affairs
connectors.validation_role: structured baseline and official local-government directory

connectors.name: Ballotpedia
connectors.query_template: {entity} Georgia SPLOST E-SPLOST T-SPLOST bond referendum
connectors.validation_role: discovery and historical context only; official ballot, resolution, election, or audited schedule required

connectors.name: HUD-USPS ZIP Code Crosswalk
connectors.validation_role: many-to-many ZIP and county relationship support

connectors.name: Official county, city, school, utility and authority sites
connectors.query_template: site:{official_domain} {entity} agenda minutes budget audit SPLOST utility capital project news
connectors.validation_role: current official evidence, normally bounded to the most recent 12–24 months

connectors.name: Official development authority and Georgia project announcements
connectors.query_template: {entity} development authority industrial park employer expansion site grant
connectors.validation_role: public economic-development activity; project claims retain primary-document confirmation

connectors.name: TCSG and USG institution sources
connectors.query_template: {entity} technical college university workforce dual enrollment program
connectors.validation_role: institution and pathway identification; partnership operation requires current agreement or announcement

connectors.name: Official utilities, MEAG, Georgia Transmission, SERTP and PSC sources
connectors.query_template: {entity} electric provider transmission plan generation storage interconnection
connectors.validation_role: publicly identifiable energy context only; never project-specific firm capacity

connectors.name: Official utility financial, capital, GEFA and permit sources
connectors.query_template: {entity} water sewer enterprise fund GEFA capital permit
connectors.validation_role: existing public system and financial context; incremental engineering capacity remains separate

connectors.name: Reputable local and regional publications
connectors.query_template: {entity} Georgia youth schools housing recreation employers infrastructure childcare downtown
connectors.validation_role: discovery or corroborating current context; material claims should not outrank primary records
